# Dates Penny is not teaching.
#
# The daily rotate-events workflow skips these when it picks the next class
# date for the Event structured data, so Google is never told about a class
# that isn't running. Each class is on its own weekday, so closing a date
# only affects the class that falls on it.
#
# One entry per line: a single date or an inclusive range, ISO format.
#   2026-12-21                 # one day
#   2026-12-21..2027-01-03     # range, both ends included
# Anything after # is ignored. Past entries are harmless and can be pruned.
